subject: Shortlist & pricing: security compliance platform renewal (Vanta / Drata / TrustCenter)
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: evelyn.hart@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 09:12 -0800
Subject: Shortlist & pricing: security compliance platform renewal (Vanta / Drata / TrustCenter)

Team —

Our Vanta contract hits renewal in Q1 and we should decide whether to renew, migrate to Drata, or consolidate around TrustCenter. Evelyn, thanks again for the SOC2 work — could you confirm the automation gaps that matter most to you?

Immediate asks:
- Evelyn: quick pros/cons and one-line recommendation by EOD Monday (automation, evidence readiness, control coverage).
- Karthik: capture procurement constraints (preferred term, PO timing, any reqs for reseller).
- Vivek: high-level budget approval range (we likely need ~ $50k–$90k ARR depending on discount).

I will reach out to each vendor this afternoon to request updated quotes and migration timelines; please CC me on any vendor conversations.

Thanks,
Aditya
Aditya Rao
Head of IT Ops — Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: jessica.wang@vanta.com, omar@drata.com, support@trustcenter.io
Cc: evelyn.hart@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 12:03 -0800
Subject: Request: updated quotes & SOC2 evidence delivery timelines (Redwood Inference)

Hi Jessica / Omar / TrustCenter team —

Redwood is evaluating options for our upcoming security tooling renewal. Can you please provide the following by next Wednesday (2025-11-27):
1) Updated 12-month and 36-month pricing (list seat/asset components and any seat tiers).
2) Onboarding timeline and hands-on migration support (hours / named support).
3) SOC2 evidence collection cadence and estimated time-to-evidence for our current control set (we have ~85 controls instrumented).
4) Contract / standard MSA and any enterprise discount thresholds.

Attach any proposal docs to replies. We aim to make a platform decision by Dec 1 to allow procurement lead time.

Thanks,
Aditya
[internal note: cc Evelyn for security details]

From: Jessica Wang <jessica.wang@vanta.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: sales@vanta.com
Date: Fri, 21 Nov 2025 08:45 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: updated quotes & SOC2 evidence delivery timelines (Redwood Inference)

Hi Aditya —

Thanks for reaching out. Attaching our 12/36 month proposal for Redwood (Vanta-proposal-20251121.pdf). TL;DR:
- 12mo: $64,800/year (enterprise package with 3 named contacts, onboarding + 20 hrs of migration support).
- 36mo: $172,000 (2% annual escrow-style increase).
- SOC2 evidence: with our connectors enabled we can surface ~70% of evidence automatically within 4–6 weeks; remaining controls typically require low-effort manual attestation.
- We offer a one-month free onboarding window and a 10% discount for 36-month commitments.

Attachments: Vanta-proposal-20251121.pdf [attachment]

Happy to do a 30-minute walkthrough next week — Tuesday or Thursday mornings PST work for me.

Best,
Jessica Wang
Enterprise Sales, Vanta
[attachment: Vanta-proposal-20251121.pdf]

From: Omar Suleiman <omar@drata.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.com, evelyn.hart@redwood.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 22 Nov 2025 10:30 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: updated quotes & SOC2 evidence delivery timelines (Redwood Inference)

Hi Aditya / Evelyn —

Thanks for the details. Attached is our line-item quote and a migration plan (Drata-quote-20251122.xlsx). Highlights:
- 12mo: $59,500/year (includes migration concierge, 30 hrs of implementation assistance, and automated evidence integrations).
- 36mo: $154,000 with a 12% prepayment discount option.
- Our automated evidence coverage estimates 75–80% for typical infra/app stacks; Drata offers pre-built runbooks that reduce manual attestation time by ~40%.

If helpful we can schedule a technical call with our onboarding lead to map connector coverage to your asset inventory.

Regards,
Omar Suleiman
Solutions Lead, Drata
[attachment: Drata-quote-20251122.xlsx]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 24 Nov 2025 11:05 -0800
Subject: Re: Shortlist & pricing: security compliance platform renewal (Vanta / Drata / TrustCenter)

Aditya / Team —

Quick evaluation summary (attached: eval-matrix-redwood-20251124.pdf):
- Drata: best automation coverage for our mix of cloud infra + k8s + CI (est. 75–80% auto). Migration concierge looks strong.
- Vanta: solid UI and reporting; requires more manual attestations on a few controls.
- TrustCenter: lightweight and cheaper but limited in connectors; better as an add-on than a primary solution.

Recommendation: proceed with Drata if procurement can secure a 12–18 month term with a migration SLA and a statement on data residency. Negotiation levers: 1) push for onboarding hours guaranteed in contract; 2) ask for a 10–12% volume discount; 3) include a 45-day post-migration rollback clause if expected automation coverage not achieved.

Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Senior Security Engineer — Redwood Inference
[attachment: eval-matrix-redwood-20251124.pdf]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: evelyn.hart@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 24 Nov 2025 16:03 -0800
Subject: Re: Shortlist & pricing: security compliance platform renewal (Vanta / Drata / TrustCenter)

Thanks all —

Agree with Evelyn. Karthik, please open a procurement request for Drata using the attached quote and request a negotiated discount (target 10–12%) and guaranteed onboarding hours in the SOW. Budget: please flag if we need formal approval beyond $75k ARR. Vivek — can you confirm approval range for this spend so I can proceed with sales negotiation?

Next steps: 
- Karthik: create PO draft and procurement ticket by EOD Wednesday (2025-11-26).
- Aditya: coordinate technical mapping call with Omar and our onboarding lead (propose Wed 11/27 10am PST).
- Evelyn: prepare the 3 non-negotiable contract clauses to include in SOW (data residency, onboarding SLA, rollback window).

I have compiled the vendor docs into combined-quotes-20251124.pdf and uploaded the HubSpot deal (HubSpot-Deal-76421). DocuSign link will follow once we have terms.

Thanks,
Aditya
[attachment: combined-quotes-20251124.pdf]
